decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:7b57d047, email:8e240c9d) or tickets. Kickoff was held (calendar:dac7c318), a modest positive signal on intent, and plan is paid Pro, but silence plus no first project with 8 days left suggests low unaided odds.

draft.subject: One quick step to get Clearwater Partners moving
draft.body:
Hi Mia,

Thanks again for making time for the kickoff last week. Since then I know things get busy, so I'll keep this short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so a first project is usually the easiest place to start. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Nadia
